title: Understanding intervals
description: Know how AftLog decides when maintenance is due.

steps.text: Intervals are time- or hours-based (e.g., 200 hours, annually).
Open an interval in the plan to see its basis.
Pro can derive intervals from your engine manual.
Adjust intervals when you know your engine's needs.

tips: Hours-based intervals use your logged engine hours.
Seasonal intervals fire around your region's season.
affects: Boat Health Score, reminders, and seasonal readiness.
examples: Why spark plugs are flagged at 200 hours.
Adjusting an interval to your real usage.
